-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def backend.fkInit (D : backend.Data) : Nat :=
  if backend.fkAbsD D then 0 else 1

def backend.fkValRv (P : backend.BParams) (v : backend.FkVals) (rv : backend.RView) : Prop :=
  backend.fkValD v rv.fst ∧ backend.fkAbsB P rv.snd.bks

def backend.RView : Type :=
  backend.Data × backend.RBuf

def backend.vData (P : backend.BParams) (rv : backend.RView) : GMap (GoString × GoString) GoString
    :=
  { lookup := fun nk => if P.HB nk.fst = true then none else backend.vOf P rv nk.fst nk.snd, finite := ⋯ }

def backend.bgOk (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) (free : Bool) (n w u : Nat) : Prop :=
  uint.Z st.R.ver + ↑n + ↑st.cnt.k < 2 ^ 40 ∧
    u ≤ w ∧
      (st.cnt.c ≤ st.cnt.k + 1 + if u = w then 1 else 0) ∧
        st.cnt.p0 ≤ sint.nat st.pend ∧
          ((st.cnt.e = 0 ∨ st.cnt.c = 0) ∧ (st.cnt.c = 0 ∨ ∀ (i : w64), backend.bkOf st.R.bks i = [])) ∧
            st.cnt.e ≤ P.hookMax * (2 ^ 40 + 2) ∧
              (∀ (i : w64),
                  (backend.bkOf st.W.bks i).length ≤ sint.nat st.pend - st.cnt.p0 + P.hookMax * st.cnt.c ∧
                    (backend.bkOf st.R.bks i).length ≤ st.cnt.p0 + st.cnt.e) ∧
                (∀ (nm : GoString) (i : w64),
                    P.BT !! nm = some i →
                      P.HB nm = false → (backend.bkOf st.W.bks i).length ≤ sint.nat st.pend - st.cnt.p0) ∧
                  (free = true → st.cnt.p0 = sint.nat st.pend ∧ (st.pend ≠ W64 0 → u < w)) ∧ ↑w ≤ uint.Z st.R.ver

theorem backend.rbData_eq {P : backend.BParams} {S S' : backend.Data} (h : ∀ (n : GoString), P.RB n
    = true → S' !! n = S !! n) : backend.rbData P S' = backend.rbData P S

def backend.hookPre (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : Prop :=
  st.cnt.hw = true ∧
    sint.Z st.pend + ↑P.hookMax < 2 ^ 58 ∧ ∀ (i : w64), backend.bkOf st.W.bks i = [] ∨ backend.bkOf st.R.bks i = []

def backend.hkData (P : backend.BParams) (S : backend.Data) : GMap (GoString × GoString) GoString :=
  { lookup := fun nk => if P.hk nk.fst nk.snd = true then backend.dget S nk.fst nk.snd else none, finite := ⋯ }

def backend.rbuf_countable : Pos.Countable backend.RBuf :=
  countableOfLeftInverse (fun r => (r.bks, r.ver)) (fun p => { bks := p.fst, ver := p.snd })
    backend.rbuf_countable._proof_1

def backend.rbClean (P : backend.BParams) (R : backend.RBuf) : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : GoString) (i : w64), P.BT !! n = some i → P.HB n = false → backend.bkOf R.bks i = []

def backend.bktOf (D : backend.Data) (n : GoString) : backend.BktData :=
  (D !! n).getD ∅

def backend.cursorRange (es : List backend.Ent) (key endKey : GoString) (limit : w64) : List
    backend.Ent :=
  have rest := List.drop (backend.seekIdx es key) es;
  if endKey = [] then List.take 1 (List.takeWhile (fun e => decide (e.fst = key)) rest)
  else
    List.take (if sint.Z limit ≤ 0 then 2 ^ 63 - 1 else (sint.Z limit).toNat)
      (List.takeWhile (fun e => decide (backend.strLt e.fst endKey)) rest)

def backend.fkWInit (P : backend.BParams) (D : backend.Data) : Bool :=
  decide (backend.fkWfD P D)

theorem backend.rbData_lookup (P : backend.BParams) (S : backend.Data) (n : GoString) :
    backend.rbData P S !! n = if P.RB n = true then S !! n else none

def backend.BParams.has (P : backend.BParams) (bi : backend.BucketInfo) : Prop :=
  P.BT !! bi.name = some bi.id

def backend.sData (P : backend.BParams) (S : backend.Data) : GMap (GoString × GoString) GoString :=
  backend.vData P (S, { bks := ∅, ver := W64 0 })

def backend.BSess.create (st : backend.BSess) (bi : backend.BucketInfo) : backend.BSess :=
  { C := st.C, S := if st.S !! bi.name = none then <[bi.name := ∅]>st.S else st.S, R := st.R, W := st.W,
    pend := st.pend + W64 1, ndel := st.ndel, tx := st.tx, cnt := st.cnt }

def backend.VFun : Type :=
  GoString → GoString → Option GoString

def backend.dget (D : backend.Data) : backend.VFun :=
  (D !! n).bind fun m => m !! k

def backend.fkOkG (P : backend.BParams) (f : Nat) (g : backend.FkG) (st : backend.BSess) : Prop :=
  backend.fkOk P f g.fst st ∧ g.snd.fst ≤ f ∧ (f = g.snd.fst → backend.fkValSt P g.snd.snd st)

def backend.fkValSt (P : backend.BParams) (v : backend.FkVals) (st : backend.BSess) : Prop :=
  backend.fkValD v st.C ∧ backend.fkAbsB P st.R.bks ∧ backend.fkValD v st.S ∧ backend.fkAbsB P st.W.bks

theorem backend.idsOk_writebackR {P : backend.BParams} {W : backend.WBuf} {R : backend.RBuf} (hW :
    backend.idsOk P W.bks) (hR : backend.idsOk P R.bks) : backend.idsOk P (backend.writebackR W
    R).bks

def backend.fkValD (v : backend.FkVals) (D : backend.Data) : Prop :=
  ∀ (n k : GoString), backend.fkKey n k → backend.dget D n k = backend.fkAt v k

def backend.viewOf (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : backend.VFun :=
  backend.ovB P.BT st.R.bks (backend.dget st.C)

def backend.FkG : Type :=
  Bool × Nat × backend.FkVals

theorem backend.hkData_lookup (P : backend.BParams) (S : backend.Data) (n k : GoString) :
    backend.hkData P S !! (n, k) = if P.hk n k = true then backend.dget S n k else none

def backend.fkWfRv (P : backend.BParams) (rv : backend.RView) : Prop :=
  backend.fkWfD P rv.fst ∧ backend.fkWfB P rv.snd.bks

def backend.fkWfB (P : backend.BParams) (B : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (n k : GoString) (i : w64),
    backend.fkKey n k → P.BT !! n = some i → ∀ (e : backend.Ent), e ∈ backend.bkOf B i → e.fst = k → P.FV e.snd

def backend.rtRange (rv : backend.RView) (bi : backend.BucketInfo) (key endKey : GoString) (limit :
    w64) : List backend.Ent :=
  have lim := backend.rangeLimit endKey limit;
  have bufR := backend.bbRange (backend.bkOf rv.snd.bks bi.id) key endKey lim;
  if ↑bufR.length = sint.Z lim then bufR
  else backend.cursorRange (backend.bktEnts (backend.bktOf rv.fst bi.name)) key endKey (lim - W64 ↑bufR.length) ++ bufR

def backend.BParams.Wf (P : backend.BParams) : Prop :=
  (∀ (n1 n2 : GoString) (i : w64), P.BT !! n1 = some i → P.BT !! n2 = some i → n1 = n2) ∧
    0 < sint.Z P.limit ∧ sint.Z P.limit ≤ 2 ^ 57 ∧ P.hookMax ≤ 2 ^ 16 ∧ ∀ (n : GoString), P.SB n = true → P.HB n = false

theorem backend.rbData_insert_other {P : backend.BParams} {S : backend.Data} {n : GoString} (b :
    backend.BktData) (h : P.RB n = false) : backend.rbData P <[n := b]>S = backend.rbData P S

def backend.viewSame (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : Prop :=
  backend.vData P (st.C, st.R) = backend.sData P st.S ∧
    ∀ (n : GoString) (i : w64), P.BT !! n = some i → P.HB n = false → backend.bkOf st.W.bks i = []

def backend.fkWfSt (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : Prop :=
  backend.fkWfRv P (st.C, st.R) ∧ backend.fkWfD P st.S ∧ backend.fkWfB P st.W.bks

def backend.ovB (BT : GMap GoString w64) (B : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)) (base : backend.VFun) :
    backend.VFun :=
  ((BT !! n).bind fun i => backend.lastVal (backend.bkOf B i) k).or (base n k)

def backend.fkAt (v : backend.FkVals) (k : GoString) : Option GoString :=
  if
      k =
        go!"finishedCompactRev" then
    v.fst
  else v.snd

def backend.fkKey_dec (n k : GoString) : Decidable (backend.fkKey n k) :=
  id inferInstance

structure backend.BCnt : Type where
  k : Nat
  c : Nat
  p0 : Nat
  e : Nat
  hw : Bool

structure backend.BParams : Type where
  BT : GMap GoString w64
  HB : Bool
  SB : Bool
  HK : Bool
  RB : Bool
  hookMax : Nat
  limit : w64
  FV : Prop

def backend.fkAbsB (P : backend.BParams) (B : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (n k : GoString) (i : w64),
    backend.fkKey n k → P.BT !! n = some i → ∀ (e : backend.Ent), e ∈ backend.bkOf B i → e.fst ≠ k

def backend.hookStep (P : backend.BParams) (st st' : backend.BSess) : Prop :=
  st'.C = st.C ∧
    st'.R = st.R ∧
      backend.sData P st'.S = backend.sData P st.S ∧
        backend.rbData P st'.S = backend.rbData P st.S ∧
          (∀ (n : GoString) (i : w64),
              P.BT !! n = some i → P.HB n = false → backend.bkOf st'.W.bks i = backend.bkOf st.W.bks i) ∧
            sint.Z st.pend ≤ sint.Z st'.pend ∧
              sint.Z st'.pend ≤ sint.Z st.pend + ↑P.hookMax ∧
                sint.Z st.ndel ≤ sint.Z st'.ndel ∧ st'.tx = st.tx ∧ st'.cnt = st.cnt

def backend.fkKey (n k : GoString) : Prop :=
  n = go!"meta" ∧
    (k =
        go!"scheduledCompactRev" ∨
      k =
        go!"finishedCompactRev")

def backend.sessWf (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : Prop :=
  st.W.Wf ∧
    st.R.Wf ∧
      backend.idsOk P st.W.bks ∧
        backend.idsOk P st.R.bks ∧
          0 ≤ sint.Z st.pend ∧
            sint.Z st.pend < 2 ^ 58 ∧
              0 ≤ sint.Z st.ndel ∧
                sint.Z st.ndel ≤ sint.Z st.pend ∧
                  (st.pend = W64 0 → ∀ (i : w64), backend.bkOf st.R.bks i = []) ∧
                    (st.ndel = W64 0 →
                        backend.agreeOff P.HB (backend.dget st.S) (backend.ovB P.BT st.W.bks (backend.viewOf P st))) ∧
                      backend.safeSt P st

def backend.fkOk (P : backend.BParams) (f : Nat) (w : Bool) (st : backend.BSess) : Prop :=
  (f = 0 → backend.fkAbsSt P st) ∧ (w = true → backend.fkWfSt P st)

def backend.fkAbsSt (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : Prop :=
  backend.fkAbsRv P (st.C, st.R) ∧ backend.fkAbsD st.S ∧ backend.fkAbsB P st.W.bks

def backend.fkOkRvG (P : backend.BParams) (f : Nat) (g : backend.FkG) (rv : backend.RView) : Prop :=
  backend.fkOkRv P f g.fst rv ∧ (f ≤ g.snd.fst → backend.fkValRv P g.snd.snd rv)

def backend.fkAbsRv (P : backend.BParams) (rv : backend.RView) : Prop :=
  backend.fkAbsD rv.fst ∧ backend.fkAbsB P rv.snd.bks

def backend.BSess.del (st : backend.BSess) (bi : backend.BucketInfo) (k : GoString) : backend.BSess
    :=
  { C := st.C, S := <[bi.name := GMap.delete k (backend.bktOf st.S bi.name)]>st.S, R := st.R, W := st.W,
    pend := st.pend + W64 1, ndel := st.ndel + W64 1, tx := st.tx, cnt := st.cnt }

def backend.dKeys (D : backend.Data) : List (GoString × GoString) :=
  List.flatMap (fun nm => List.map (fun kv => (nm.fst, kv.fst)) (GMap.toList nm.snd)) (GMap.toList D)

theorem backend.dget_isSome_mem (D : backend.Data) (n k : GoString) (h : (backend.dget D n k).isSome
    = true) : (n, k) ∈ backend.dKeys D

def backend.BSess.put (st : backend.BSess) (bi : backend.BucketInfo) (k v : GoString) (seq : Bool) :
    backend.BSess :=
  { C := st.C, S := <[bi.name := <[k := v]>(backend.bktOf st.S bi.name)]>st.S, R := st.R,
    W := if seq = true then st.W.putSeq bi.id (k, v) else st.W.put bi.id (k, v), pend := st.pend + W64 1, ndel := st.ndel,
    tx := st.tx, cnt := st.cnt }

def backend.safeSt (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : Prop :=
  backend.safeRv P (st.C, st.R) ∧
    ∀ (n : GoString) (i : w64),
      P.BT !! n = some i →
        P.SB n = true →
          ∀ (kc vc : GoString) (e : backend.Ent),
            backend.bktOf st.C n !! kc = some vc → e ∈ backend.bkOf st.W.bks i → backend.strLt kc e.fst

theorem backend.vOf_isSome_mem (P : backend.BParams) (rv : backend.RView) (n k : GoString) (h :
    (backend.vOf P rv n k).isSome = true) : (n, k) ∈ backend.vKeys P rv

def backend.fkWfD (P : backend.BParams) (D : backend.Data) : Prop :=
  ∀ (n k v : GoString), backend.fkKey n k → backend.dget D n k = some v → P.FV v

def backend.fkAbsD (D : backend.Data) : Prop :=
  ∀ (n k : GoString), backend.fkKey n k → backend.dget D n k = none

def backend.fkVals (D : backend.Data) : backend.FkVals :=
  (backend.dget D go!"meta"
      go!"finishedCompactRev",
    backend.dget D go!"meta"
      go!"scheduledCompactRev")

theorem backend.rbData_delete_other {P : backend.BParams} {S : backend.Data} {n : GoString} (h :
    P.RB n = false) : backend.rbData P (GMap.delete n S) = backend.rbData P S

structure backend.BSess : Type where
  C : backend.Data
  S : backend.Data
  R : backend.RBuf
  W : backend.WBuf
  pend : w64
  ndel : w64
  tx : Loc
  cnt : backend.BCnt

def backend.vOf (P : backend.BParams) (rv : backend.RView) : backend.VFun :=
  backend.ovB P.BT rv.snd.bks (backend.dget rv.fst)

def backend.freeOk (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) : Prop :=
  backend.sessWf P st ∧
    sint.Z st.pend < sint.Z P.limit ∧
      st.ndel = W64 0 ∧
        (∀ (n : GoString) (i : w64), P.BT !! n = some i → P.HB n = false → backend.bkOf st.W.bks i = []) ∧
          st.cnt.hw = false

def backend.vKeys (P : backend.BParams) (rv : backend.RView) : List (GoString × GoString) :=
  List.flatMap (fun nm => List.map (fun kv => (nm.fst, kv.fst)) (GMap.toList nm.snd)) (GMap.toList rv.fst) ++
    List.flatMap (fun ni => List.map (fun e => (ni.fst, e.fst)) (backend.bkOf rv.snd.bks ni.snd)) P.BT.toList

def backend.agreeOff (HB : GoString → Bool) (f g : backend.VFun) : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : GoString), HB n = false → ∀ (k : GoString), f n k = g n k

theorem backend.hkData_eq {P : backend.BParams} {S S' : backend.Data} (h : ∀ (n k : GoString), P.hk
    n k = true → backend.dget S' n k = backend.dget S n k) : backend.hkData P S' = backend.hkData P
    S

def backend.FkVals : Type :=
  Option GoString × Option GoString

def backend.fkOkRv (P : backend.BParams) (f : Nat) (w : Bool) (rv : backend.RView) : Prop :=
  (f = 0 → backend.fkAbsRv P rv) ∧ (w = true → backend.fkWfRv P rv)

def backend.rbData (P : backend.BParams) (S : backend.Data) : GMap GoString backend.BktData :=
  GMap.filter (fun n x => P.RB n) S

theorem backend.lastVal_isSome_mem {l : List backend.Ent} {k : GoString} (h : (backend.lastVal l
    k).isSome = true) : ∃ e, e ∈ l ∧ e.fst = k

def backend.BSess.delBucket (st : backend.BSess) (bi : backend.BucketInfo) : backend.BSess :=
  { C := st.C, S := GMap.delete bi.name st.S, R := st.R, W := st.W, pend := st.pend + W64 1, ndel := st.ndel + W64 1,
    tx := st.tx, cnt := st.cnt }

def backend.BParams.hk (P : backend.BParams) (n k : GoString) : Bool :=
  P.HB n && P.HK n k

def backend.safeRv (P : backend.BParams) (rv : backend.RView) : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : GoString) (i : w64),
    P.BT !! n = some i →
      P.SB n = true →
        ∀ (kc vc : GoString) (e : backend.Ent),
          backend.bktOf rv.fst n !! kc = some vc → e ∈ backend.bkOf rv.snd.bks i → backend.strLt kc e.fst

def backend.idsOk (P : backend.BParams) (B : GMap w64 (List backend.Ent)) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i : w64) (es : List backend.Ent), B !! i = some es → ∃ n, P.BT !! n = some i

def backend.rangeLimit (endKey : GoString) (limit : w64) : w64 :=
  if endKey = [] then W64 1 else if sint.Z limit ≤ 0 then W64 (2 ^ 63 - 1) else limit
